name: Automated Browser help
description: Help mode entries for the Automated Browser plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Automated Browser
entries.text: A real Chrome running on the VPS. What you see is a live picture of it: tap, type and scroll right on it and the VPS browser does it. Logins stay saved per workspace.

entries.title: Address bar
entries.text: Type a web address (or words to search) and press Enter. Private and internal addresses are blocked so the browser can't reach services on the VPS.

entries.title: Back
entries.text: Goes back one page in the current tab.

entries.title: Forward
entries.text: Goes forward one page in the current tab.

entries.title: New tab
entries.text: Opens another tab in the VPS browser. Tap a tab to show it.

entries.title: Device size
entries.text: Shows sites the way a phone, tablet or desktop sees them.

entries.title: Zoom
entries.text: Makes the live picture bigger or smaller on your screen. The page itself doesn't change.

entries.title: Keyboard
entries.text: On a phone, opens your keyboard so what you type goes into the field you tapped in the VPS browser.

entries.title: Screenshot
entries.text: Saves a picture of the page. Password fields are always blacked out.

entries.title: Downloads
entries.text: Files the VPS browser downloaded. Tap one to save it to this device.

steps.title: A browser on the VPS
steps.text: This is a live picture of Chrome running on the VPS. Everything you tap, type and scroll goes to it.

steps.title: Workspaces
steps.text: Each workspace keeps its own cookies and logins, so a routine that logs in stays logged in.

steps.title: Claude can drive it too
steps.text: Every button here is also a command Claude, Amber and Gizmo can use over MCP and the CLI.
